GHARDEKHO RENTERS • GDR

Find rental homes across India

GharDekho Renters is a rental property platform for people looking for a house for rent, room for rent, PG, hostel, or other rental home in India. Search by city or area, monthly rent, BHK, furnishing and availability, then explore properties and connect with owners.

Rental homes and houses for rent

Explore rental homes based on your budget, preferred location, BHK and property type.

Rooms, PGs and hostels

Students and working professionals can look for rooms, PGs and hostels near their preferred area.

Find rental property near you

Use location-based discovery to explore available rental properties around the area you choose.

Connect with property owners

GharDekho helps renters discover listings and request visits directly from property owners.

GharDekho Renters FAQs

What can I find on GharDekho?

You can discover rental homes, houses, rooms, PGs and hostels, with filters for location, rent, BHK, furnishing and availability.

Can I search for a ghar for rent near me?

Yes. Use the location search and nearby-property features to explore rental listings around your selected area.

Does GharDekho connect renters with owners?

Yes. GharDekho Renters is designed to help renters discover properties and connect with property owners for visits and rental enquiries.
